title: The Sage & Pink Friendsgiving Outfit
description: A sage and pink Friendsgiving outfit: an oversized sage cable knit sweater, light wide leg jeans, pink fur-lined ankle boots, gold heart hoops, a pink quilted chain bag and pink claw clips.
intro: Every year I swear I'll wear something cute to Friendsgiving and every year I end up in leggings holding a pie. Not this year. A big sage cable knit, light wide leg jeans, pink fur-lined boots and a quilted pink bag that holds my keys and nothing else. Gold heart hoops and a pink claw clip because my hair will be up by 4 pm anyway. Comfy enough for second helpings, cute enough for the group photo.

sections.heading: The sweater and jeans
paragraphs: The Trendy Queen oversized cable knit sweater in Dark Sage is the cozy base. Sidefeel high waisted wide leg jeans in Light Blue keep it relaxed and long.

sections.heading: Pink from the ground up
paragraphs: Faux suede ankle boots with a pink fur lining and a little buckle, plus a pink quilted crossbody bag on a gold chain.

sections.heading: The finishing touches
paragraphs: ToHeart gold heart hoop earrings and a 4-pack of 5 inch gradient pink claw clips for the half-up, I-did-try look.

sections.heading: What is real and what is styling
paragraphs: The products are the pieces linked here. The porch, hallway, pie and everything else in the photos are styling extras.
